title: Nuclear innovation is advancing NY’s energy transition (Guest Opinion by Doreen M. Harris)
summary: NYSERDA President Doreen M. Harris advocates for nuclear innovation as a key strategy in New York State's energy transition. The opinion piece promotes advanced nuclear technologies as solutions for achieving climate and energy goals, relevant to Syracuse's sustainability and economic development priorities.
